title: 2025年12月四级真题 第2套 阅读1
paperTitle: 2025年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
passage:
P1 Junk food is now a staple of many Americans' diets. Advertising campaigns from the snack food companies, often featuring sports stars, send the message that we can neutralize any negative effects of consuming their products simply by getting more physical exercise. But recent studies show a lack of exercise is not to blame for rising obesity rates. Bad diets are.

P2 Interventions(干预) to help reduce junk food consumption are especially important for children and teenagers. Prevention is better than cure because obesity is so difficult to treat. Unfortunately, while health education has shown some success among young children, teens have been harder to reach.

P3 Now a large-scale study has tried an innovative approach to change teenagers' attitudes towards healthy eating, and the results are promising. The researchers argued that previous interventions have probably been unsuccessful because of a major flaw: they focused on a future, healthier you and assumed that this would be enough motivation for teenagers. In contrast, the new intervention cleverly exploits teenagers' instinct for rebelliousness and autonomy, and the value they place on social justice.

P4 To do this, researchers had students read an article on the food industry. It revealed a secret about the manipulative and deceptive strategies used to make junk food more addictive and characterize the products as healthy. The article also explained how advertising campaigns specifically target very young and poor people, causing harm for these vulnerable groups. Afterwards, the participants read a fictional survey of teens who wanted to "fight back against the companies by buying and eating less processed food"

P5 After the intervention, participants associated healthy eating with autonomy and social justice. The teenagers also rated healthy eating as being more appealing. Importantly, there were also some promising effects of the new intervention on actual behavior. A day later the students were offered a choice of snacks and drinks in a seemingly unrelated context. The teens chose healthy snacks and drinks (such as fruit or water) more often over unhealthy options (like biscuits and soda). Apparently associating a healthy diet with teenagers' own values seems to be a promising avenue to prevent obesity.

questions.q: What do we learn about advertising campaigns from the snack food companies?
options: They convey the idea that their products are ok if consumers exercise more.
They send the message that bad diets are responsible for Americans' obesity.
They usually feature sports stars to emphasize the benefits of their snack foods.
They claim that lack of exercise is to blame for the increasing obesity rates.
questions.explain:
【判型】What do we learn about advertising campaigns from the snack food companies? 是 What do we learn about X 句式，问的是关于 X 的已知事实，不 含 infer/suggest/imply。

【拆句】What do we learn about advertising campaigns from the snack food companies? 主 干 What do we learn about X，X = advertising campaigns，后面 from the snack food companies 是介词短语修饰 campaigns，结构平铺无陷阱。

【定位】Advertising campaigns from the snack food companies, often featuring sports stars, send the message that we can neutralize any negative effects of consuming their products simply by getting more physical exercise. 零食公司的广告活动经常以体育明星为主角，传递的信息是：只要多做体育锻炼，就能抵消 食用其产品带来的任何负面影响。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 we can neutralize any negative effects of consuming their products simply by getting more physical exercise ↔their products are ok if consumers exercise more 预判"广告称多运动就能抵消坏处"和 A 的 their products are ok if consumers exercise more 完全对得上。 B) 张冠李戴 They send the message that bad diets are responsible for Americans' obesity. 说 的是广告传达"坏饮食才是肥胖元凶"——但这其实是 Bad diets are 这句作者引述研究 的结论，与广告立场恰恰相反。 C) 偷换概念 They usually feature sports stars to emphasize the benefits of their snack foods. 说请明星是为了"强调零食本身的好处"——但原文 often featuring sports stars 后接的 逻辑是"运动能抵消坏处"，明星是"运动"的化身，不是为吹嘘零食优点。 D) 与原文相反 They claim that lack of exercise is to blame for the increasing obesity rates. 说广 告主张"缺乏锻炼导致肥胖"——这是后文研究的反方观点 a lack of exercise is not to blame 的镜像，而且原文是 not to blame，D 偷偷把 not 去掉。 文章关于健康教育说了什么？ A) 它阐明了青少年叛逆和自主的本能。 B) 它更加强调治疗而非预防。 C) 它对反肥胖运动几乎没有贡献。 D) 它在使青少年远离垃圾食品方面基本上失败了。 47. What does the passage say about health education? A) It has shed light on teens' instinct for rebellion and autonomy. B) It has placed much more emphasis on cure than on prevention. C) It has contributed little to the campaigns against obesity. D) It has largely failed to turn teens away from junk food.

questions.q: What does the passage say about health education?
options: It has shed light on teens' instinct for rebellion and autonomy.
It has placed much more emphasis on cure than on prevention.
It has contributed little to the campaigns against obesity.
It has largely failed to turn teens away from junk food.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the passage say about health education? 直接问"文章关于 X 怎么说"，要 求复述事实。

【拆句】What does the passage say about health education? 主干 What does the passage say about X，X = health education，结构无陷阱。

【定位】Unfortunately, while health education has shown some success among young children, teens have been harder to reach. 遗憾的是，虽然健康教育在低龄儿童中取得了一定成效，但对青少年的影响一直很难触达。

【选项】A) 张冠李戴 It has shed light on teens' instinct for rebellion and autonomy. 说健康教育"揭示了 青少年的叛逆本性"——但 instinct for rebelliousness and autonomy 是第三段的 new intervention 才用到的概念，与第二段 health education 无关。 B) 偷换概念 It has placed much more emphasis on cure than on prevention. 说健康教育"更重 治疗轻预防"——但原文 Prevention is better than cure because obesity is so difficult to treat. 是作者对干预总体的观点，并未说健康教育"更重治疗"。 C) 以偏概全 It has contributed little to the campaigns against obesity. 全盘否定健康教育，但原 文 health education has shown some success among young children 明确承认对 儿童有成效，并非"几乎无贡献"。 D) ✓ 正确 teens have been harder to reach ↔largely failed to turn teens away from junk food Unfortunately ↔largely failed 预判"对青少年没奏效"与 D 的 largely failed to turn teens away from junk food 完全 契合。 先前帮助减少垃圾食品消费的干预措施有什么重大缺陷？ A) 它们只是暂时激励青少年远离垃圾食品。 B) 它们关注年轻人未来将获得的益处。 C) 它们基于这样的假设：动机是唯一的关键。 D) 它们无法诉诸青少年的叛逆本能。

questions.q: What is a major flaw in previous interventions to help reduce junk food consumption?
options: They motivated teens to stay away from junk food only temporarily.
They focused on the benefits young people would reap in the future.
They were based on the assumption that motivation was the only key.
They were incapable of appealing to teens' instinct for rebelliousness.
questions.explain:
【判型】What is a major flaw in previous interventions to help reduce junk food consumption? 直问 What is，要的是文中明确写出的具体缺陷。 48. What is a major flaw in previous interventions to help reduce junk food consumption? A) They motivated teens to stay away from junk food only temporarily. B) They focused on the benefits young people would reap in the future. C) They were based on the assumption that motivation was the only key. D) They were incapable of appealing to teens' instinct for rebelliousness.

【拆句】What is a major flaw in previous interventions to help reduce junk food consumption? 主干 What is a major flaw，后跟两层修饰：in previous interventions 限 定缺陷的归属，to help reduce junk food consumption 是不定式修饰 interventions 的 功能。要看清 flaw 修饰的是 previous interventions，不是别的。

【定位】The researchers argued that previous interventions have probably been unsuccessful because of a major flaw: they focused on a future, healthier you and assumed that this would be enough motivation for teenagers. 研究者认为，以往的干预之所以可能失败，是因为一个重大缺陷：它们把重心放在"未来更 健康的你"，并假设这就足以激励青少年。

【选项】A) 无中生有 They motivated teens to stay away from junk food only temporarily. 说"只在短 期有效"——但原文从未提及干预的"短期/长期"时效问题，only temporarily 属凭空 捏造。 B) ✓ 正确 focused on a future, healthier you ↔ focused on the benefits young people would reap in the future 预判"押注未来好处"和 B 的 focused on the benefits young people would reap in the future 完全契合。 C) 过度推断 They were based on the assumption that motivation was the only key. 把原文 assumed that this would be enough motivation 扭成"动机是唯一关键"——原文只 说"这一点已经足够"，未说"动机是唯一"。 D) 张冠李戴 They were incapable of appealing to teens' instinct for rebelliousness. 说"以前的 干预无法触动叛逆本能"——叛逆本性是 new intervention cleverly exploits teenagers' instinct for rebelliousness 的卖点，反推回去"以前没用"是考生自己脑补 的，原文并未把"未利用叛逆本能"列为 flaw。 新的干预措施在哪些方面具有创新性？ A) 它强调人们的社会责任感。 B) 它巧妙地利用了青少年的个人弱点。 C) 它利用了青少年的天然倾向。 D) 它承诺即时而非未来的益处。

questions.q: In what way is the new intervention innovative?
options: It emphasizes people's sense of social responsibility.
It cleverly exploits teenagers' personal weaknesses.
It takes advantage of teenagers' natural inclination.
It promises immediate rather than future benefits.
questions.explain:
【判型】In what way is the new intervention innovative? 问的是"以何种方式"，答案在原文有具 体描述。

【拆句】In what way is the new intervention innovative? 主干 the new intervention is innovative，前置 In what way 提问。innovative 是表语形容词，整句结构简单。

【定位】In contrast, the new intervention cleverly exploits teenagers' instinct for rebelliousness and autonomy, and the value they place on social justice. 与之相对，新干预巧妙地利用了青少年对叛逆和自主的本能，以及他们对社会公正的重视。

【选项】A) 偷换概念 It emphasizes people's sense of social responsibility. 只抓住 the value they place on social justice 这一点，且把 teenagers 扩大成 people、把 social justice 偷换成 social responsibility。 B) 偷换概念 It cleverly exploits teenagers' personal weaknesses. 把 instinct for rebelliousness and autonomy 这一中性偏正面的"本能"扭曲成 personal weaknesses（个人弱点）； 原文并未把叛逆视为"弱点"。 C) ✓ 正确 exploits teenagers' instinct for rebelliousness and autonomy ↔ takes advantage of teenagers' natural inclination 预判"顺势利用青少年天性"和 C 的 takes advantage of teenagers' natural inclination 一一对应。 D) 过度推断 It promises immediate rather than future benefits. 说新干预"承诺即时好处"——但 原文从未提"即时好处"，且作者把"许诺未来好处"作为 previous interventions 的缺 陷，并不意味着新干预走"即时好处"的反向路线。 从新研究中可以得出什么结论？ A) 可以采用完全不同的方法来对抗零食广告宣传活动。 B) 必须找到有效的干预措施来说服青少年转向更健康的生活方式。 C) 通过在青少年的价值观与健康饮食之间建立联系，有望预防肥胖。 D) 战胜肥胖的创新方法是揭露食品公司的操纵性和欺骗性做法。

questions.q: What conclusion can be drawn from the new research?
options: A totally different approach could be adopted to combat advertising campaigns for snack food.
An effective intervention has to be found to persuade teenagers to switch to a healthier lifestyle.
Obesity can be hopefully prevented by building links between teenagers' values and healthy eating.
An innovative way to beat obesity is to expose food companies' manipulative and deceptive
questions.explain:
【判型】What conclusion can be drawn from the new research? 让你为整篇研究下结论，覆盖 全文而非某一段。

【拆句】What conclusion can be drawn from the new research? 被动结构 conclusion can be drawn from X，相当于 What conclusion does the new research lead to。注意 drawn from 是"从…得出"，不要看反。

【选项】A) 以偏概全 A totally different approach could be adopted to combat advertising campaigns for snack food. 把"反击广告"当作研究结论——但 fight back against the companies by buying and eating less processed food 只是干预里使用的"虚构问卷"内容，是实 验素材，不是研究结论。 B) 与原文相反 An effective intervention has to be found to persuade teenagers to switch to a healthier lifestyle. 把"得找到有效干预"作为结论——但本研究本身已经提出并验证了一 种有效干预，结论是"这条路有希望"而不是"还得继续找"。 C) ✓ 正确 associating a healthy diet with teenagers' own values seems to be a promising avenue to prevent obesity ↔ Obesity can be hopefully prevented by building links between teenagers' values and healthy eating. teenagers' own values ↔teenagers' values C 既包含"青少年价值观"又包含"健康饮食"和"防肥胖"三个要素，正好对应主线串出的 结论。 D) 以偏概全 An innovative way to beat obesity is to expose food companies' manipulative and deceptive practices. 把"揭露食品公司套路"当结论——但 the manipulative and deceptive strategies 只是新干预里给学生看的材料之一，并非研究结论本身。研究结 论是"把饮食与青少年价值观挂钩"，揭露公司只是其中的具体手段。
